# How to price a subscription product

## Transcript

Sample Guest (00:00:00):
When you price a subscription product, the biggest mistake founders make is
anchoring on cost instead of value. You should interview ten customers about
what they'd pay before you ever ship a pricing page.

Lenny (00:00:30):
That's such a good point about customer interviews before pricing decisions.
